responsibility: This definition file is the canonical list of hard-coded GCC plugin events. Through repeated inclusion with different DEFEVENT macro expansions, it drives generation of the plugin_event enum, the parallel event-name string table, and related dispatch logic, documenting the major lifecycle, parsing, pass-manager, attribute, pragma, GGC, include-file, and analyzer initialization callback points that plugins can register for before any dynamically allocated events are added.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/plugin.cc’s runtime loader/callback implementation and gcc/plugin.h’s API declarations, this file is the X-macro definition list of built-in plugin events that is repeatedly included to generate the plugin_event enum and parallel event-name tables.
